summary: Tested the new IA (AI Assistants) module. Backend endpoint POST /api/ai/assistant validated for all 4 personas (comercial, fotografico, financeiro, marketing) using authenticated JWT session — all return 200 with PT-PT replies. Financeiro persona correctly injects real studio data (overdue clients, receivables/payables totals). Frontend /ia page renders 4 tabs, tab switching works, quick actions trigger AI responses (copy button appears), custom textarea + send button works. Session continuity confirmed via session_id.

issues: Recharts warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — cosmetic, likely a container that renders before layout; not blocking.

action_items: Optional: silence Recharts width/height(-1) warnings on dashboard by ensuring container has explicit min-height or by rendering only after mount.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/ai/assistant does NOT scope queries by organization_id — _assistant_context calls db.clients/quotes/sessions/invoices/receivables/payables.find({}) with no org filter. Contradicts the stated tenant isolation requirement. In a multi-tenant setup this leaks other tenants' data into the LLM prompt. Should filter by user['organization_id'] taken from Depends(get_current_user).
server.py is now 2931 lines — consider splitting by domain (auth, ai, finance, galleries, store) into routers.
AI endpoint has no rate limiting; each call ~15s of gpt-5.4 usage. Consider a per-user throttle.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded data via /api/seed autouse fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI assistants module is functional end-to-end. Endpoint requires Bearer JWT (login via /api/auth/login). ASSISTANT_PERSONAS dict at server.py:2165, endpoint at server.py:2244. Tenant isolation is claimed but NOT implemented for the AI context query (see critical review). If org scoping is added later, re-run test_iteration22_ai_assistants.py after ensuring test user has an organization_id.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects blocking; single design concern is missing organization scoping in _assistant_context.
